title: Short Bali Escape with Flights
alt: Tanah Lot sea temple at sunset, Bali
transport: Return flights, private transfers and guided tours

stops.name: Ubud
stops.subtitle: Ubud to Kintamani
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Pool resort a short ride from central Ubud

activities.name: Kintamani and rice terrace day tour
activities.description: Coffee plantation tasting on the climb to Kintamani, the crater lake view, Tegenungan waterfall, the Tegalalang terraces and the jungle swing.

activities.name: Ubud art market
activities.description: Two floors of carvings, batik, woven bags and silver in the middle of town, quietest and cheapest when the stalls first open.

program.name: Ubud
program.description: Two nights inland to open the trip, with a coffee plantation road up to Kintamani and the rice terraces at Tegalalang.

stops.name: Kuta
stops.subtitle: Kuta to Bedugul and Uluwatu
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Quiet pool hotel walking distance from Kuta beach

activities.name: Bedugul lakes and Tanah Lot sunset
activities.description: The Handara gate, the lake temple of Ulun Danu Beratan at Bedugul, then the sea temple of Tanah Lot as the sun goes down.

activities.name: Water sports, Padang Padang and Uluwatu
activities.description: Banana boat and jet ski at Tanjung Benoa, the cove at Padang Padang beach, then Uluwatu temple above the surf for sunset.

program.name: Kuta
program.description: Two nights on the coast, reached by way of the Bedugul lakes, with water sports at Tanjung Benoa and the Uluwatu cliffs.

1: Flight from Delhi to Denpasar, included in your package
Arrival at Ngurah Rai Airport and private transfer to your hotel
Check in at your Ubud resort and settle in
Rest of the day free among the rice fields
2: Breakfast, then a full day out with your own car and guide
Coffee plantation tasting on the climb to Kintamani
Tegenungan waterfall and the Tegalalang rice terraces
A turn on the jungle swing above the valley
3: Breakfast and check out, then north to the Handara gate
Ulun Danu Beratan, the temple standing on the lake
Sunset at Tanah Lot, the sea temple on the rocks
Check in at your Kuta hotel near the beach
4: Breakfast, then a morning at Tanjung Benoa beach
Banana boat and jet ski with an instructor
Padang Padang beach in its limestone cove
Uluwatu temple on the cliffs at sunset
5: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Private transfer to Ngurah Rai Airport for your return flight

expert.name: Putu
expert.quote: Four nights, flights included, both sides of the island. This is the long weekend Bali that actually works.
expert.tip: With only four nights, keep the touring to one day in each base and fly out on an evening service so you still get a last morning by the pool. We will hold your bags after check out.

summary: A five day Bali break with return flights: two nights in Ubud for Kintamani and the rice terraces, then two in Kuta by way of the Bedugul lake temples, with water sports and Uluwatu at sunset on the last full day.
included: Included: return flights from Delhi; 4 nights with daily breakfast; private airport and inter city transfers; Kintamani and rice terrace tour; Bedugul and Tanah Lot sunset tour; water sports with Padang Padang and Uluwatu.
not_included: Not included: Indonesia visa fees; lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
